address: Poznań Congress Centre, Śniadeckich 25, Poznań, 60-773, Poland
bio: Just to the side of the Poznan Congress Centre is this spacious Spanish restaurant serving up the usual tapas suspects. You’ll find Padrón peppers and patatas bravas all present and correct, alongside more filling main dishes and a selection of pintxos. Strong, satisfying flavours run throughout, while the flan is a terrific incarnation of a classic dessert. A small fridge is filled with Spanish goodies to buy and take home, including olive oil and almonds....
